description: This is a PHP unit test class for the SkillService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations and search functionality related to skills, mocking the SkillDao dependency.

classes.name: SkillServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SkillService, testing CRUD and search methods with mock dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment, initializes SkillService, and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests the deleteSkills() method of SkillService with mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a skill by ID through SkillService.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests saving a new Skill via SkillService.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests searching for skills and returning a list.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests obtaining the count of skills matching search criteria.
